en.headline: Green Form home buyers queue for discounted Kowloon Bay flats
en.dek: Flat selection under the Green Form Subsidised Home Ownership Scheme 2025 begins, with more than 800 units at Shing Chi Court offered at 60 per cent of market value.
body: Flat selection for the Sale of Green Form Subsidised Home Ownership Scheme Flats 2025 began on Tuesday, drawing applicants to the Housing Authority sales office in Kwun Tong.

The main offering is the new Shing Chi Court development in Kowloon Bay, which provides more than 800 flats with saleable areas ranging from about 280 to 469 square feet. Prices are set at 60 per cent of assessed market value, between HK$1.68 million and HK$3.54 million.

The Housing Authority is also making available around 120 previously sold Green Form flats and about 400 recovered units from the Tenants Purchase Scheme. Priority is given to public rental housing tenants affected by clearance projects at Wah Fu Estate, Choi Hung Estate, Ma Tau Wai Estate and Sai Wan Estate.
Eligible applicants, including public housing tenants and Green Form certificate holders, are invited in batches according to their priority category.

zh.headline: 綠置居九龍灣盛緻苑今日起揀樓
zh.dek: 「綠表置居計劃」2025的揀樓今日展開，九龍灣盛緻苑提供逾800個單位，以市值六折發售。
body: 房屋委員會「綠表置居計劃」2025的揀樓今日（25日）展開，申請人前往觀塘銷售處選購單位。
是次主要供應為九龍灣新發展的盛緻苑，提供逾800個單位，實用面積約280至469平方呎，售價定為評估市值的六成，介乎168萬至354萬港元。
房委會同時提供約120個轉售綠置居單位，以及約400個收回的租者置其屋計劃單位。優先次序給予受清拆影響的公屋租戶，包括華富邨、彩虹邨、馬頭圍邨及西環邨的部分住戶。
合資格申請人包括公屋租戶及綠表資格證明書持有人，將按申請類別分批獲邀選樓。
